banner.title: Cookies and tracking
banner.body: We use strictly necessary cookies to run Stack32. Analytics (including session replay) and advertising pixels only load if you accept them. You can change your mind at any time.
banner.doNotSell: Do not sell or share my data

preferences.title: Cookie preferences
preferences.description: Choose which optional cookies we may use. Strictly necessary cookies are always on because the site cannot work without them. Your choice is stored for 13 months.
preferences.gpcNote: Your browser sent a Global Privacy Control signal. Advertising / “sale or share” cookies stay off.

necessary.title: Strictly necessary
necessary.description: Authentication, security, language, theme, and remembering this choice. Always on.

analytics.title: Analytics & product improvement
analytics.description: First-party measurement with PostHog, including page views and session replay with form fields masked. Used to understand how the product is used — not to show ads.

marketing.title: Advertising pixels
marketing.description: Meta (Facebook) and TikTok pixels to measure campaigns and retargeting. These partners may process data in the United States.
